edit.description: guidanceBody/guidanceRules: each endpoint kind's rule also carries its contracted requirements (identity, prose, satisfiers) and each edge field's intent, in and out
requirement and edge intent reach both endpoint kinds' rules

summary: A kind's synthesized guidance rule carries the requirements its members satisfy (identity, prose, satisfiers) and each edge field's intent at both endpoint kinds' loci
acceptance: a program whose skill satisfies a requirement and whose kind declares a guided edge field emits rules at both endpoints' loci carrying the requirement and the edge intent; pnpm --dir sdk test green
notes: SDK-only (PROTOCOL, Tests). 0092 Consequences. Edge intent is the field guidance (0091), stated once on the declaring kind and delivered at the target kind's rule too. A shipped kind still projects none of its shipped counsel; a rule over it carries only the program's own contracts (0092's own example is a skill). A requirement with a declared kind but no satisfier still reaches that kind's rule.
